interpretations: Select films with `replacement_cost > 20.99`; group by `rating` and show the rating, `AVG(length)` excluding nulls, and `AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)` calculated per film, with no rounding.
Select films with `replacement_cost >= 20.99`; group by `rating` and show the rating, `AVG(length)` excluding nulls, and `AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)` calculated per film, with no rounding.
queries:
SELECT rating,
       AVG(length) AS avg_length,
       AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
GROUP BY rating

SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(length),
  AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
GROUP BY rating
